summary.text: Tony Wisniewski is a Republican member of the Idaho House of Representatives for District 5, Seat B, listed by the Idaho Legislature as serving a fourth term.

paragraphs.text: The legislature lists Wisniewski as a retired engineer and small business owner, and its biography says Wisniewski was born in Los Angeles and holds a B.S. in mechanical engineering from Utah State University.
The biography also says Wisniewski was chairman of the Spokane chapter of the Society of Manufacturing Engineers and a four-term vice chairman of the Kootenai County Republican Central Committee.
